description: This Java class defines a service for watching changes to entities within the Apache OFBiz framework. It provides a method to monitor specific fields or entire entities for changes and logs relevant information.

classes.name: EntityWatchServices
classes.description: Provides a static method to monitor entity changes and log updates.

methods.name: watchEntity
methods.description: Monitors changes to a specified entity or field, logs the change details, and returns a success response.
